Which departments listed the most rules in the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?

What is the average molecular weight of the BACE-1 benchmark compounds?
SELECT avg(mw) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bace
Where do children under 15 make up the largest share of a metro area's people?

SELECT name, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END) / sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) = 0 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END), 1) AS pct_under_15 FROM govblock_census.popest_cbsa_est_alldata_char WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did FCC complaints about cell phone billing go up or down from 2016 to 2024?

SELECT substr(date_created, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE method LIKE 'Wireless%' AND issue LIKE '%Billing%' AND substr(date_created, 7, 4) IN ('2016', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which events happen most often in a patent application's file history?
SELECT event_code, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_patents.patex_transactions_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of screened compounds showed activity against HIV?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN hiv_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv
What outcomes are recorded most often for appellate decisions?
SELECT disposition, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE disposition IS NOT NULL AND disposition <> '' AND disposition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dockets were opened in the Southern District of Texas in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE court_id = 'txsd' AND substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2020'
Which papers from 2012, the year the Higgs boson was found, have been cited most?
SELECT title, try_cast(citation_count AS integer) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE substr(earliest_date, 1, 4) = '2012' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many pieces of research software are archived in the Zenodo collection?
SELECT count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE resource_type_general = 'Software'
Which retired power plants were the largest?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT plant_name, state, round(sum(mw)) AS retired_mw FROM (SELECT plant_code, plant_name, state, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How large was New York State's labour force in 2024?
SELECT value AS labor_force FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000006' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M13'
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most granted patents?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r: Department of Health and Human Services

How many papers have been withdrawn from PubMed's records?
SELECT count(*) AS deletions FROM govblock_health.pubmed_deletions
Which kinds of molecules does ChEMBL hold?
SELECT molecule_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE molecule_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules on the fall 2024 agenda were expected to be major rules?
SELECT count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' AND major = 'Yes'
Which California ZIP codes have the highest average income per tax return? (2021)
Income by ZIP Code and County

SELECT zipcode, 1000 * sum(try_cast(a00100 AS double)) / sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS avg_agi FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE state = 'CA' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' AND zipcode NOT IN ('00000', '99999') GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) >= 1000 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When was the first patent application in the file published?
Which states saw the most home loans made in 2022?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal facilities reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _21_federal_facility = 'YES'
Which NIH institutes are credited with funding the most PubMed papers?
SELECT agency, count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_grants WHERE agency LIKE '%NIH HHS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in deposits did FDIC-insured banks hold at the end of 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(dep AS double)) AS deposits_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20241231'
Which day of the week was deadliest on American roads in 2022?
SELECT day_weekname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many substations operate at 500 kilovolts or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations WHERE try_cast(max_volt AS double) >= 500
Which agencies pass the most federal awards on to the organisations they fund?
SELECT passthrough_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_passthrough WHERE passthrough_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem bioassays are confirmatory tests?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN aid2activityoutcomemethod = 'Confirmatory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod
Which customer sectors have the most utility rate schedules?
SELECT sector, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE sector IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who is listed as the chief officer of Cornell University?
SELECT instnm, chfnm, chftitle FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE instnm LIKE 'Cornell University%' LIMIT 5
How did mortgage denial rates differ by applicant sex in 2023?

SELECT derived_sex, round(100.0 * count_if(cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3') / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many coal-fired units reported to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which sources have deposited the most substances in PubChem?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug mechanisms in ChEMBL involve inhibiting the target?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type = 'INHIBITOR'
How are GDB-11's molecules spread across sizes, by number of heavy atoms?
SELECT heavy_atoms, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11 WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York City's highest hourly electricity load in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which operating nuclear reactors have the largest generating capacity?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, try_cast(capacity_mwe AS double) AS mwe FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Who bought the mortgages lenders made in 2023: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae or nobody?

SELECT CASE cast(purchaser_type AS varchar) WHEN '0' THEN 'not sold' WHEN '1' THEN 'Fannie Mae' WHEN '2' THEN 'Ginnie Mae' WHEN '3' THEN 'Freddie Mac' WHEN '4' THEN 'Farmer Mac' WHEN '5' THEN 'private securitiser' WHEN '6' THEN 'bank or savings association' WHEN '71' THEN 'credit union or mortgage company' WHEN '72' THEN 'life insurer or credit union' ELSE 'other' END AS buyer, count(*) AS loans, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do New York's Davis-Bacon wage determinations set for electricians, in pay and fringe benefits?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate, round(avg(try_cast(fringe AS double)), 2) AS avg_fringe FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE wd_number LIKE 'NY%' AND classification LIKE 'ELECTRICIAN%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

r: Plymouth Rock Assurance Corporation of New York
Plymouth Rock Assurance Corporation of New York

How many U.S. wind turbines have been retrofitted with new parts?
SELECT count(*) AS retrofitted FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(t_retrofit AS varchar) = '1'
In which states do Davis-Bacon determinations set the highest carpenter wages?

SELECT substr(wd_number, 1, 2) AS state, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE classification LIKE 'CARPENTER%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drugs are approved or being tested for multiple sclerosis, according to ChEMBL?
SELECT count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading = 'Multiple Sclerosis'
What types of patent does the USPTO grant, and how many of each?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
